Hi , we will be building an attendance application today and i have to give out the json export of out chats too . Now keeping that in mind Build the Android attendance app from the attached text  Follow the assignment requirements closely and keep the implementation simple, clean, and focused. The submission will be reviewed by the hiring team.
Stack
Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + MVVM
Room for local-only storage; no backend
Hilt for DI
CameraX for front-camera capture
ML Kit Face Detection
MobileFaceNet/TFLite for face embeddings
FusedLocationProviderClient for location
Navigation Compose + single Activity
Screens
Login — dummy credentials: admin/admin, staff/staff
Admin — Staff List
Admin — Add Staff
Admin — Face Enrolment
Staff — Mark Attendance
Admin — Staff Profile / Attendance History
Data
Staff: id, name, employeeId, faceEmbedding, enrolledSelfiePath
Attendance: id, staffId, date, time, selfiePath, latitude, longitude, matched
Face recognition
Capture selfie using CameraX.
ML Kit verifies exactly one face.
Crop the detected face and generate an embedding using MobileFaceNet/TFLite.
Store the embedding during enrolment.
During attendance, generate a new embedding and compare using cosine similarity.
Use a configurable threshold, initially around 0.65.
Save attendance only when the face matches.
Keep recognition logic inside a reusable FaceRecognitionManager.
Handle no face, multiple faces, failed recognition, and missing enrolment gracefully.
Attendance History
For each staff member, show their attendance records with:
Selfie
Date
Time
Latitude
Longitude
Build order
Room + Hilt
Login + Navigation
Staff CRUD
CameraX capture
ML Kit detection
MobileFaceNet embedding + matching
Face enrolment
Attendance + location + timestamp
Attendance history
README + APK
Prioritize a working end-to-end solution over unnecessary abstractions or features. Do not fake face recognition. If MobileFaceNet integration is blocked, document the limitation clearly in the README.
Also ensure the final project includes the required GitHub repository, APK, README, and ChatGPT/Claude conversation JSON export. For the initial part we can skip the ML Kit detection and we can wire that up later but the flow needs to be implemented now Android Attendance App — Hiring Assignment

Objective
Build a simple Android attendance app with two types of users: Admin and Staff.
The main focus of this assignment is selfie-based face recognition and recording
attendance details.
1. Login
Create a simple login screen.
For the assignment, you can use dummy credentials for Admin and Staff.
2. Admin
Staff List
● View a list of staff
● Add a new staff member
● Open a staff member’s profile

Add Staff
Admin enters:
● Staff name
● Employee ID
Admin can then enrol the staff member's face using the phone's camera.
3. Staff
After logging in, the staff member should see a Mark Attendance button.
When the staff member taps it:
● Open the front camera
● Take a selfie
● Recognise the face
● Check that it matches the enrolled face
● If the face matches, record attendance
● Store: Staff ID, Date, Time, Selfie, Latitude, Longitude
Attendance should only be recorded if the face matches.
4. Admin — Attendance
Admin should be able to tap any staff member and view their
attendance records. For each attendance record, show:
● Selfie

● Date
● Time
● Latitude
● Longitude
5. Required Screens
Keep the app to these basic screens:
● Login
● Admin — Staff List
● Admin — Add Staff
● Admin — Face Enrolment
● Staff — Mark Attendance
● Admin — Staff Profile / Attendance History
6. Technical Requirements
● Use the phone’s front camera
● Enrol a staff member’s face
● Recognise the face when marking attendance
● Capture the selfie
● Capture current latitude/longitude
● Capture date/time
● Store attendance records
● Display attendance records to the admin
You can use any reasonable Android technology stack and backend/database.
7. Submission
Please submit:
● GitHub repository
● APK
● Short README with: Technology/architecture used, How to run the app, Any
assumptions or limitations, Demo credentials
● JSON export of your Claude/ChatGPT conversation .

### 1. Staff Logout

* Add a clearly accessible Logout option for Staff.
* Logging out should clear the current session/role and return to Login.
* Prevent going back into the Staff screen using the back button after logout.

### 2. Prevent Face Overwriting

This is the most important fix.

Currently, with the single `staff/staff` credential, I was able to enroll my face and later enroll another person's face, which overwrote the existing face.

For now there is only one Staff credential, so enforce:

**One staff credential → one enrolled face.**

* If the staff account already has an enrolled face, do NOT allow another face to replace it.
* The Face Enrolment screen should detect that a face is already enrolled and show an appropriate message such as:
  **"Face already enrolled for this account."**
* Do not overwrite the existing embedding or selfie.
* If a re-enrollment flow is needed later, it should be an explicit Admin action rather than happening automatically.
* Make sure this protection exists at the data/business-logic level, not only in the UI.

For the Admin-created staff records, each staff member's face must remain associated with their own `staffId` and must never overwrite another staff member's embedding.

### 3. Face Recognition

The current recognition sometimes fails after a few minutes. Keep the current implementation for now; do not artificially lower the threshold or fake successful matches.

Make sure:

* The enrolled embedding is persisted correctly.
* Attendance compares against the correct staff member's stored embedding.
* Failed recognition gives a clear user-facing message.
* Do not overwrite the enrolled embedding during attendance.

Focus on:

* Better spacing, typography, hierarchy and consistency.
* Clear primary/secondary actions.
* Better loading states.
* Clear success/error states.
* Camera/enrolment instructions.
* Disable buttons while processing.
* Make navigation/back behavior intuitive.

* Improve the Staff List and Attendance History readability.
